profile.headline: Web Developer at Grand Canyon University
profile.summary: Highly accomplished Full-Stack Developer with over 15 years of experience specializing in Microsoft technologies, including C#, ASP.NET Core, Angular, and SQL Server. Passionate about solving complex business problems and crafting exceptional user experiences, consistently delivering innovative solutions that strengthen business objectives. Proven expertise across the full SDLC, from requirements gathering and architecture to robust development, testing, and production support. Adept at modernization initiatives, DevOps pipeline automation (Azure DevOps/VSTS), TFS administration, and applying standard methodologies and best practices to drive efficient and reliable software delivery.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Modernized critical document management systems by re-architecting and migrating them to Angular and .NET Core, significantly improving system performance, scalability, and user experience.

Led full-stack web development initiatives for new and existing business solutions, leveraging C#, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, Entity Framework, Dapper, and SQL Server to deliver robust and scalable applications.

Developed and launched a secure Student Portal website using Azure Active Directory for robust authentication and single sign-on, enhancing user experience and security for 100,000+ students.

Refactored and re-architected the Degree Program Calculator (formerly Net Price Calculator), optimizing its performance and accuracy, and integrated it with XRM to enable efficient import of new programs, streamlining curriculum management.

Designed, developed, and maintained robust CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps (formerly VSTS) to automate build, test, and release processes for multiple web applications, reducing deployment time and improving release frequency.

Created internal NuGet packages to standardize code sharing and promote reusability across development teams, accelerating development cycles and ensuring consistent application of best practices.

Developed and implemented a custom Azure DevOps pipeline task to automate the deployment of Task Scheduler applications, streamlining a previously manual process and ensuring consistent, error-free deployments.

Administered and provided ongoing support for Azure DevOps, managing version control, project configurations, and build/release definitions for our development team.

positions.title: Senior Computer Analyst
positions.description:
Refactored and enhanced the Technology Service Request System (TSRS), a critical internal application written in C# with a SQL database backend, improving its architecture to a layered approach for better maintainability and scalability.

Provided new and existing development support for various business groups, ensuring the delivery of high-quality software solutions.

Mentored junior developers on best practices in C# development and application architecture, fostering team growth and skill development.

Administered and supported TFS for source control and build management.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained web applications for various departments using N-Layer architecture, MVC, LINQ, Entity Framework, Web Services (WCF), and SQL.

Integrated Pay Flow Pro into web applications, enabling secure payment processing functionality.

Provided ongoing maintenance and support for legacy applications, ensuring continued functionality and resolving critical issues.

Led code review meetings, promoting code quality, adherence to standards, and knowledge sharing within the development team.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Managed and developed new/existing software projects and websites for 6 company divisions, utilizing N-Tier application architecture and SQL.

Administered and supported Microsoft IIS and SQL Servers, ensuring optimal performance and availability of web applications.

Developed data integration packages (DTS) for Access/SQL/AS400, streamlining data flow and reporting.

positions.title: Web Developer / Computer Administrator
positions.description:
Provided technical support and troubleshooting for client websites, resolving issues to ensure uptime and functionality.

Contributed to new development and implementation of custom web solutions and SEO services.
